decisions.reason: The construction dumper was only mentioned on the website and has little visible commitment, but it fits the firm's construction focus and the missing evidence since 2019 does not clearly show failure, so management would rather persist than admit a misstep.

The inclined furniture lift is a multi-model line with its own page and is central to the lifting direction the firm announced, so the investment and public commitment favour keeping it despite unclear results.

The building material lift is a multi-model line with a dedicated page that ties into the construction and lifting strategy, so management would attribute any weak results to temporary market conditions and continue.
The truck-mounted lift has its own page and builds on the lift platform the firm committed to, so it is kept, though as a single niche variant it is somewhat more exposed than the core lift lines.
